route_title: L-BFGS-B Optimized Three-Cavity Filter with QWOT-Seeded Initialization
compilation_rationale: Compiled task defines a 21-layer alternating Ge/ZnS stack on CaF2 for normal incidence. Initial thicknesses of 400 nm approximate quarter-wave optical thickness at 4.45 μm while respecting the 50–500 nm bounds. Four mean-transmittance targets enforce dual-passband maximization and dual-stopband minimization across 3.6–5.2 μm using the smatrix solver. Robustness evaluated via relative uniform thickness sampling.
